# SECURITY CATEGORIES The Officer Commanding places every part of the colony in one of four categories. Changes are posted on the front page and may come at any change of watch. Should a sign and a sentry disagree, the sentry is right.
## CATEGORY GREEN [color=#7FBF7F][bold]OPEN[/bold][/color] - Living blocks, the mess, shops, the clinic waiting room and the bar. - No checks. Patrols pass through. Do carry your identification.
## CATEGORY AMBER [color=#D4AF37][bold]CONTROLLED[/bold][/color] - Landing pads, fuel stores, the power plant, the atmosphere and water works, the signals relay and Colony Administration. - Identification checked at the door. Bags may be searched. No loitering, no photographs.
## CATEGORY RED [color=#E06060][bold]RESTRICTED[/bold][/color] - The garrison lines, armoury, vehicle park, operations room and the perimeter fence. - Entry only under escort with a written pass. Sentries are authorised to use force to stop an intruder.
## CATEGORY BLACK [color=#FFFFFF][bold]EXCLUSION[/bold][/color] - Declared during an emergency: a gas leak, a fire, a cave-in, a quarantine, unexploded charges or an engagement. - Nobody crosses the cordon, resident or Marine, unless detailed to the response. When the air is bad, the line is the line.
## MARKINGS - Chevron striping on a barrier marks the edge of a category. - Hazard striping marks a checkpoint lane. Stop at the painted bar. - Flashing amber lights on a cordon mean Category Black. Turn about.
Changes are also carried by the [netlink="Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] when the press is on shift.
